verdict.rationale: Token2 supports pre-registering keys at scale only for Microsoft Entra ID: a bulk-enrollment tool built on the FIDO2 Provisioning Graph API sets random PINs, manages keys and logs results, and there is a PowerShell/Graph automation guide plus an Entra hardware-token CSV/JSON export for TOTP. Bulk configuration is limited to PIN setting, and lifecycle tracking amounts to enrollment logs and per-device JSON/CSV audit dumps. Missing for 10: a centralized fleet inventory or lifecycle console for issued keys, IdP-agnostic bulk provisioning beyond Entra, broader bulk configuration beyond PINs, and independent corroboration of at-scale use.
